# ASC Development

> ASC Development builds fast, conversion-focused websites and lead systems for UK home service businesses, and makes them visible in Google search and in AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity.

ASC Development is a UK web and marketing studio for home service businesses: plumbers, heating engineers, electricians, roofers, builders, landscapers, cleaners, pest control, locksmiths and home improvement trades. The focus is getting the business found and winning more work, not design for its own sake.

## What ASC Development does
- Builds fast, mobile-first websites designed to convert visitors into enquiries.
- Sets up lead systems: missed-call text-back and enquiry capture so no lead is lost.
- Manages local SEO and Google Business Profiles so clients rank for "near me" searches.
- Does Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO / AI-visibility): structuring a client's website and data so AI assistants recommend them when people ask for a tradesperson in their area.
- Runs automated review generation to grow a client's Google rating.

## Who ASC works with (home services)
- Plumbing and heating: plumbers, heating and gas engineers, boiler installers, bathroom fitters
- Electrical and energy: electricians, EV charger installers, solar and battery installers
- Roofing and building: roofers, builders, scaffolders, loft and extension specialists
- Gardens and outdoors: landscapers, gardeners, tree surgeons, fencing and driveway installers
- Cleaning and pest control: domestic cleaners, window and gutter cleaners, carpet cleaners, pest control
- Home improvement: kitchen fitters, carpenters, painters and decorators, plasterers, locksmiths, handymen
- ASC also takes on a small number of healthcare and e-commerce clients where its approach is a good fit.

## What the monthly plan includes
- Rankings for the specific services each client wants more enquiries for
- Google Maps visibility for "near me" searches, targeting the top three map results in the client's area
- Visibility in AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude) when homeowners ask who to call
- Technical fixes: page speed, mobile layout, site structure and structured data
- Trust signals search engines look for: reviews, directory listings, consistent business details
- A dedicated account lead, weekly updates and a monthly performance report; no call centres or chatbots

## Targets ASC works towards
- 2 to 5 times growth in enquiries from search
- Top 3 Google Maps position in the client's area
- 3 to 6 months for results to build and compound

## How ASC works with clients
1. Book a call: https://calendar.app.google/pe51YxujVH79eFK3A
2. Onboarding
3. Work begins within 48 hours

- Websites go live in about 10 days from the first call.
- One flat monthly price covers the website, hosting, SEO, Google Business management, AI-visibility and reviews.
- No large upfront build fee and no long contract.
- Guarantee: "Get leads, or you don't pay."
